_comment: FaZe Points challenges (owner: Omar). period: daily (resets 00:00 UTC) | weekly (resets Monday 00:00 UTC); each can be claimed once per period. metric: clips | clip_reactions | threads | comments. clip_reactions counts upvotes on Community posts sharing clips posted in the same period. Max earnable is about 565 points a week, so big rewards take months.
